content.text: {"what_it_is":{"claims":[{"text":"The TAO Fleet Oiler program funds construction of the T-AO 205 John Lewis-class fleet oiler under the Shipbuilding and Conversion, Navy account.","citation":{"fact_id":"e3c199bcd4cc8b84"}},{"text":"The T-AO 205 John Lewis Fleet Oiler Class will recapitalize (replace) the existing T-AO 187 fleet oiler class.","citation":{"fact_id":"e3c199bcd4cc8b84"}},{"text":"The Navy's Combat Logistics Force (CLF) oilers supply fuel and dry cargo to Navy ships at sea, and the T-AO 205 Class will operate as shuttle ships moving supplies from resupply posts to customer ships.","citation":{"fact_id":"e3c199bcd4cc8b84"}},{"text":"Working alongside a dry cargo and ammunition ship (T-AKE), the oilers will accompany a Carrier Strike Group (CSG) and stay on station to provide fuel to customer ships as required.","citation":{"fact_id":"e3c199bcd4cc8b84"}},{"text":"For fiscal year 2026, the Department requests a total of $1,861,705 thousand (about $1.86 billion) and two ships for the T-AO 205 program.","citation":{"fact_id":"038e1ca79f6e0f3f"}}]},"why_it_matters":{"claims":[{"text":"The FY 2026 request combines $8,346 thousand of discretionary funding with $1,853,359 thousand of mandatory (reconciliation) funding, for the total of $1,861,705 thousand.","citation":{"fact_id":"1905e0d556018c76"}},{"text":"The mandatory and discretionary funds support the contract award of 2 T-AO Fleet Oilers.","citation":{"fact_id":"e3c199bcd4cc8b84"}},{"text":"The discretionary portion of the FY 2026 request is $8,346 thousand.","citation":{"fact_id":"3ba25be55bab6afa"}},{"text":"The mandatory (reconciliation) portion of the FY 2026 request is $1,853,359 thousand — the bulk of the funding, which the Navy notes is detailed in Section 20002 (Shipbuilding) of the Reconciliation Exhibit.","citation":{"fact_id":"da391702b902c455"}},{"text":"In FY 2024, the program recorded $938,315 thousand (about $938 million) in actual funding, showing a substantial planned increase in the FY 2026 request.","citation":{"fact_id":"44da7a281dff2153"}},{"text":"For FY 2025, the program was enacted at $227,154 thousand (about $227 million).","citation":{"fact_id":"bea6aeb8b89d2f88"}}]},"players":{"claims":[{"text":"The program is managed by the Department of the Navy (organization code N).","citation":{"fact_id":"44da7a281dff2153"}}]},"recent_developments":{"claims":[]}}
